PPTX → AV Script

Turn a PowerPoint into a two-column Word script: the slide picture on the left (VIDEO), the speaker notes on the right (AUDIO).

🔒 Runs offline — your file never leaves this device

How it works

  1. 1
    UploadChoose or drop your .pptx file below.
  2. 2
    ReviewCheck each slide and edit the audio text if needed.
  3. 3
    DownloadClick “Download Word document” to get your AV script.
Slides look different from PowerPoint? (optional)

For an exact match, export your deck as a PDF from PowerPoint (File > Save As > PDF) and add it here. The slide pictures then come straight from PowerPoint. Pick the PDF and the .pptx in either order. Tip: tick “Include hidden slides” if your deck has any.

Pick a presentation to begin.

Your script is ready

Edit the audio text in any row, give the document a title, then download. The Word file also includes a consolidated copy of all notes at the end.
